coverImageAlt: A blank warm-paper sheet folds into a freestanding cyan-edged architectural scaffold locked by one orange fold.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A single blank sheet folded into a stable architectural scaffold with connected spaces for product intent, users, requirements, and delivery, expressing a template that turns source material into an integrated product plan.
Scene/backdrop: Warm-paper floor fading into a deep slate studio field, uncluttered and free of tools or screens.
Subject: One dominant freestanding origami scaffold made from warm paper, with four large connected planes and bridges; cyan fold edges reveal structure and one small orange locking fold provides stability.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; precision paper folding, subtle fibers, crisp creases, and architectural model photography rendered as illustration.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; low frontal three-quarter view; strong sculptural silhouette distinct from flat documents and layered sheets; crop-safe focal subject; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical; restrained cyan rim light and soft grounded shadows with a sparing orange locking fold.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: fibrous heavyweight paper, matte folded edges, subtle embossed depth without marks.
Constraints: original image; coherent PRD-template family yet unmistakably distinct through a freestanding origami silhouette; every plane completely blank and unmarked; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: paper airplane, recognizable animal origami, icon-like symbols, architectural lettering, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, Microsoft-like gradients.
